This means that the gap-filler radars must be able to detect the same objects as the radars in service in KYRA. The gap-filler radars must be able to operate uninterrupted under severe weather conditions offered at the locations of the windmill installations at sea within the Danish waters, including but not limited to the North Sea, Kattegat and the Baltic Sea. DALO intends to use the Products, Spare Parts and Services of the Agreement to compensate for the negative influence that the current and future windmill projects will have on KYRA. This means that the Agreement will be used individually for each windmill project. normalized.description: The Maynooth University School of Business was established in 2007 and currently employs over 100 academic, administrative, and support staff as well as a student body of over 4,000 full time undergraduate and postgraduate students. The School of Business offers a range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and PhD programmes across a wide range of business disciplines as well as offering a suite of modules within the Arts programme. The teaching and learning experience of our students involves a series of face-to-face lectures within our state-of-the-art facilities within Maynooth’s campus delivered primarily by academic faculty but can also include guest lectures from industry. The School’s collective pedagogical strategy is further enhanced by Moodle, an online learning environment whereby learning materials, supplementary readings, case studies, or other media resources facilitating additional student engagement with individual modules. As evidence from students remains a critical element of our ongoing curriculum review procedures, we require a comprehensive student feedback solution to curate, distribute, and manage live student surveys as well as to analyse and disseminate the collected data.
